\"\"\"Leave-one-out cross-validation across cell types.

For each CT in training data:
  - Hold it out as \"target\"
  - Train on remaining CTs
  - Predict stimulated expression for held-out CT controls
  - Compare to held-out CT stimulated ground truth
  
Reports per-CT MSE and average MSE.
\"\"\"
import sys
import importlib.util
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
from sklearn.preprocessing import MaxAbsScaler
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

def load_method(path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate_method', path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def main():
    method_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/workspace/solution/method.py'
    train_path = '/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad'
    
    adata = sc.read_h5ad(train_path)
    cell_types = sorted(adata.obs['cell_type'].unique())
    print(f\"Cell types: {cell_types}\")
    print(f\"Total cells: {adata.shape[0]}, Genes: {adata.shape[1]}\")
    
    method = load_method(method_path)
    device = 'cpu'  # CPU is fine for these simple methods
    
    mses = {}
    for held_out_ct in cell_types:
        # Split train / held-out
        train_mask = adata.obs['cell_type'] "'!= held_out_ct
        train_adata = adata[train_mask].copy()
        
        held_out_ctrl = adata[(adata.obs['"'cell_type'] == held_out_ct) & 
                               (adata.obs['condition'] == 'control')].copy()
        held_out_stim = adata[(adata.obs['cell_type'] == held_out_ct) & 
                               (adata.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated')].copy()
        
        # Fit scaler on training cells (all conditions)
        scaler = MaxAbsScaler()
        train_adata.X = scaler.fit_transform(train_adata.X)
        held_out_ctrl.X = scaler.transform(held_out_ctrl.X)
        
        # Build and train model
        model = method.build_model(train_adata, device, 42)
        method.train_model(model, 42)
        
        # Predict
        pred = method.predict(model, held_out_ctrl, scaler, 10042)
        
        # Ground truth stim expression (log1p scale, original)
        if hasattr(held_out_stim.X, 'toarray'):
            true_stim = np.asarray(held_out_stim.X.toarray()).astype(np.float64)
        else:
            true_stim = np.asarray(held_out_stim.X).astype(np.float64)
        
        pred = np.asarray(pred, dtype=np.float64)
        
        true_mean = true_stim.mean(axis=0)
        pred_mean = pred.mean(axis=0)
        
        mse = float(mean_squared_error(true_mean, pred_mean))
        corr = float(pearsonr(true_mean, pred_mean)[0])
        mses[held_out_ct] = mse
        print(f\"  {held_out_ct:25s}: MSE={mse:.6f}, PCC={corr:.4f}, n_ctrl={held_out_ctrl.shape[0]}, n_stim={held_out_stim.shape[0]}\")
    
    avg_mse = np.mean(list(mses.values()))
    print(f\"\\nAverage LOO MSE: {avg_mse:.6f}\")
    print(f\"Per-CT MSEs: {mses}\")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
